sources.title: Service Public Burkina Faso: e-visa MSECU directory entry
sources.publisher: Service Public, Government of Burkina Faso
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government Service Public directory has a separate e-visa card assigned to MSECU. Its literal href is 'visaburkina.bf', without a scheme, so it is a malformed relative link and does not independently authenticate the canonical Visa Burkina URL; the live Embassy link does.

sources.title: Embassy of Burkina Faso in Türkiye: current online short-entry visa process
sources.publisher: Embassy of Burkina Faso in Türkiye
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Burkina Faso diplomatic-government service page identifies the Ankara Embassy, directs short-entry applicants to VisaBurkina, and describes delivery of an EVISA email attachment after acceptance.

sources.title: Visa Burkina: electronic-visa FAQ
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of the National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government Service Public directory authenticates VisaBurkina as an MSECU e-visa service; the live portal footer identifies the Ministry of Security and Directorate General of the National Police.
sources.supportingExcerpt: le visa électronique est envoyé, après approbation ministérielle, par e-mail au requérant

sources.title: Visa Burkina: entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of the National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: This live entry-conditions page belongs to the Government-authenticated MSECU VisaBurkina service and retains the Ministry of Security/National Police footer.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Un visa d’entrée ou un accord de visa ou un permis ou titre de séjour sauf exemption

sources.title: National Police: undated legacy border-visa guidance
sources.officialityEvidence: The live police.gov.bf public-service page is titled Police Nationale du Burkina Faso - Visa, but gives no publication or update date. Its legacy border-issuance and fee wording has no current nationality scope and is not current proof of a route.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Au niveau des frontières terrestres, tout étranger qui veut pénétrer sur le territoire burkinabé ne peut prendre qu’un visa de sept (7) jours.

sources.title: Government Information Service: 11 September 2025 African visa-fee decision
sources.publisher: Government Information Service of Burkina Faso
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Government Information Service publication reports the Council of Ministers decision and quotes the Minister of Security defining its Africa-wide fee-waiver scope.
sources.supportingExcerpt: la gratuité ne signifie pas exemption de visa
